title: Rectangular bar
spec: To construct a rectangular bar, start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face, which consists of a single loop. This loop includes four lines: the first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.0); the second line starts at (0.75, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.125); the third line starts at (0.75, 0.125) and ends at (0.0, 0.125); and the fourth line completes the loop by starting at (0.0, 0.125) and ending at the origin (0.0, 0.0). After drawing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it using Euler angles of zero degrees and translating it with a vector of zero. Finally, extrude the transformed sketch 0.0375 units along the normal direction to create a solid body. The final dimensions of the rectangular bar are 0.75 units in length, 0.125 units in width, and 0.0375 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.125) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.125) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a rectangular bar
r = r.extrude(0.0375)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
